policy.distance: absolute difference of M5 robot-centre horizontal range and true robot-centre horizontal range <=30cm; NOT 2D point error
policy.capped: raw>=100 is mechanically evaluated by M5 for labels and marked capped; not a runtime localization point
policy.ambiguity: two or more same-color packages satisfy both gates; excluded from performance denominators
policy.unknown: missing/invalid exact truth or raw values; explicitly reported, never silently counted as false
policy.baseline: per-observe requested confidence threshold only; category routing and WM 40<=raw<90 eligibility are separate
policy.dev_scope: only raw calibration collections and v28r1; derived calibration selected-row tables are never used
